name: pyadi-jif-explorer
description: Desktop wrapper for the PyADI-JIF Tools Explorer (Streamlit)

scripts.prebuild:win: npm run render:installer && node scripts/fetch-python.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && node scripts/fetch-wheels.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.prebuild:mac: npm run render:installer && node scripts/fetch-python.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && node scripts/fetch-wheels.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64
scripts.prebuild:linux: npm run render:installer && node scripts/fetch-python.mjs --platform linux --arch x64 && node scripts/fetch-wheels.mjs --platform linux --arch x64 && node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs --platform linux --arch x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prebuild:mac && electron-builder --mac && node scripts/build-mac-pkg.mjs
